tagline: AI Crop Disease Detection & Outbreak Risk System

hero.title: Protect Your Harvest with AI-Powered Disease & Outbreak Risk Intelligence
hero.subtitle: Upload a photo of your leaf. Get instant diagnosis, local environmental outbreak risk prediction, and safe extension treatment protocols.

analyze.title: Analyze Crop Leaf
analyze.upload_instruction: Take a clear, well-lit photo of the affected leaf
analyze.tip_1: Focus on a single leaf showing visible spots or lesions
analyze.tip_2: Ensure natural, bright sunlight without deep shadows
analyze.tip_3: Avoid blurry hands or extremely distant shots
analyze.analyzing: Analyzing leaf image and calculating environmental risk...

result.uncertain_desc: The model confidence is below the diagnostic threshold or leaf features are ambiguous. Please consult your local agricultural extension officer.
result.risk_advisory: Advisory estimate based on agronomic thresholds; not a laboratory forecast.
result.safety_note_1: Always read and strictly follow the chemical manufacturer product label.
result.safety_note_2: Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (gloves, mask, eye protection).

feedback.title: Diagnostic Feedback
feedback.prompt: Did this diagnosis match your crop's real field condition?
feedback.select_actual: Select the correct disease if known
feedback.consent_checkbox: I consent to contributing this image and label to help retrain and improve future AI models.
feedback.thank_you: Thank you! Your feedback helps protect farms worldwide.
